source_title: Orders of November 2, 2026: rates for credit accident and health insurance for 2027 (Order Numbers 2026-04 and 2026-05)
summary: South Carolina's Director of Insurance set the credit accident and health prima facie rates for 2027 by Orders 2026-04 and 2026-05 dated November 2, 2026, after tentative rates in Bulletins 2026-03 and 2026-04 (September 10, 2026) drew no hearing request. Single premium rates per $100 of initial indebtedness fall about 15%; the 3-day retroactive rate for Consumer Finance Law loans falls from $0.17 to $0.14 (the order cites a 15% reduction). Headline rates are the 12- and 60-month rates.
